text:
maria.pm: Quick summary from pilot surveys: demand for a low-priced starter SKU (~$200/mo), prepaid burst credits, and a premium 'priority lane' for tail-latency.

leah.sales: Sales confirm — smaller SKU would reduce friction. Customers like prepaid burst packs instead of forced upgrades.

akshay.eng: Implementation options: minimal (API + billing for prepaid credits) = ~3 sprints; full (add routing/priority lane) = ~9 sprints.

omar.finance: Recommend prepaid packs (50k/200k/1M tokens). Need margin models; target ~30% gross. I'll share the sheet.

katie.legal: Legal ok with starter + credits if we add expiration (30 days) and non-refundable clause. Priority lane requires SLA language; need extra review.

maria.pm: Proposal: Phase 1 = starter SKU + prepaid burst packs (deliver in ~6 weeks using minimal route). Phase 2 = priority lane in Q3. Launch criteria for Phase 1: 3 pilot commitments OR projected >$25k/mo ARR + legal addendum.

akshay.eng: I'll take option minimal. Plan: sprint1 API + billing, sprint2 console UI, sprint3 tests & hardening. Will post scope doc by EOD.

leah.sales: GTM approved; request one complimentary small pack for pilots (expires 30d).

omar.finance: Ok conditional on promo modeling.

katie.legal: Drafting addendum now.

marvin-bot: Files uploaded: survey-results.csv, pricing-model.xlsx (links).

maria.pm: Great. Final pricing sync Friday 10am. Thanks everyone :rocket:
